additions.reason: The Rebbe uses explicit bechina language: 'וצריך להתעלם שם בבחינת עיבור' — the required state of hiddenness within the path IS עיבור (the gestation period). עיבור is the period of gestation inside the womb, distinct from הריון (pregnancy as a state) and closely linked to it. The text pairs the need to 'warm oneself there like a fetus in the mother's womb' (כמו עובר במעי אמו) with the word עיבור. This is a bechina: the concealment and warming within the new path IS the uterine gestation period. עיבור belongs in Package 1 alongside הריון and הדרך חכמה/אשה הרה, since it is another face of the same spiritual pregnancy metaphor — specifically the interior period of development before birth.
additions.source_quote: וְצָרִיךְ לְהִתְעַלֵּם שָׁם בִּבְחִינַת עִבּוּר, כִּי עֲדַיִן לֹא נִתְגַּלֶּה זֶה הַדֶּרֶךְ בָּעוֹלָם

additions.reason: The Rebbe cites the verse מִשְׁלֵי ד:יא as itself a bechina of הריון: 'אֲזַי הוּא בְּחִינַת הֵרָיוֹן, בִּבְחִינַת (מִשְׁלֵי ד): בְּדֶרֶךְ חָכְמָה הֹרֵיתִיךָ, בְּחִינַת הֵרָיוֹן'. The verse 'I have taught you in the way of wisdom' (הוריתיך, from the root ירה / הריון) is called a bechina of הריון because the word הוריתיך etymologically carries the meaning of pregnancy/conception (הריון). The verse is thus presented as an expression of the same essential nature as הריון — it belongs in Package 1 as confirming that the path of wisdom is intrinsically a generative, pregnant teaching.
additions.source_quote: בִּבְחִינַת (מִשְׁלֵי ד): בְּדֶרֶךְ חָכְמָה הֹרֵיתִיךָ, בְּחִינַת הֵרָיוֹן

analysis_notes.notes: All 10 nodes from the 5 bechina edges are assigned to packages — no orphans. The dataset contains only bechina edges for reference 1020; all eitza (causal) relationships are not encoded in the bechina subgraph and correctly belong between packages rather than within them. The core causal structure of the Torah is: מחלוקת (evil cause, not in bechina dataset) →eitza→ premature fame (Package 2 domain) →eitza→ destruction of the derech (Package 1 domain). Two missing bechina concepts were identified from the source text: (1) עיבור — the Rebbe uses 'בבחינת עיבור' to describe the required state of concealment within the path, making it a bechina of the path-as-pregnancy in Package 1; (2) בדרך חכמה הוריתיך — the verse from Mishlei is explicitly called 'בחינת הריון' because of the shared root הריון/הוריתיך, making it a bechina confirmation of Package 1's central equivalence. The Torah does not have an explicit evil-domain bechina structure — מחלוקת appears only in eitza roles (as cause), not in any bechina equation. The damage it causes (premature revelation / nefal) is described in neutral metaphor language rather than evil-polarity bechina language.
